thread:
zoe: quick note from today ran a small bring-up: atlas-40b int4 + our 2-branch speculative decode on the factual-NQ split. latency -16%, but EM -3.8 on short numeric answers.

 kai: thanks. any run ids/config?

 zoe: run: rw-eval/2026-04/exp-6120. cfg: atlas-40b-int4, spec-branches=2, cutoff=0.02, kv-share=true, prefill=256. deterministic seed.

 rachel: that reads like the int4+kv-share pattern we've seen. can you dump top-5 logits around failure spots?

 zoe: added --dump-branch-logits 30. initial spot-check: many failures are date/number tokens; tokenization sometimes splits years which amplifies rounding.

 mike: short mitigation: rerank candidates using float32 scoring (no regen). cheap and recovered ~80% EM on a 200-sample. cost +25% CPU.

 kai: medium: try soft-prefetch (store prefix KV in fp16) then run int4 for decoding. prototype showed fewer drift cases.

 zoe: queued soft-prefetch run exp-6122 and no-kv-share run exp-6123. ops-bot: can you allocate a11x-small for ~30m?

 ops-bot: jobs queued. est start 2026-04-05T11:05Z. allocated pool: research-a11x.

 rachel: add a gating rule too: only spawn branches when top1-top2 < 0.06. that should cut bad branches.

 zoe: added gating run exp-6124. TL;DR so far: root cause likely tiny logits flips at numeric tokens amplified by branch merges under int4+shared-KV. short-term: rerank; medium: soft-prefetch + gating; long-term: quant kernel fix. will post aggregated numbers and worst-30 dumps when done.
